source_state: modified working-tree candidate, not a published production release
environment: Single runs in the managed cloud environment, using local disposable Chromium profiles.
scope: Only the two extended workspace runs below; this does not report the whole release suite.

dataset.notes: Synthetic tasks with projects, tags, descriptions and partially completed subtasks.

runtime_note: Bounded explicit-zone Intl formatters (64) and validity results (128), live current-zone resolution, lazy/paged import conflict controls and ordinary timeline card limits.

methodology.timings: Elapsed milliseconds around named scripted operations; includes browser interaction and driver work, not pure rendering CPU time.
methodology.comparison: Different workload and harness from performance-baseline.json; do not interpret these as its direct before/after pair.
methodology.memory: Browser heap and process RSS were not measured. Export byte counts are file sizes, not memory usage.
methodology.limits: Cloud single-run observations are not mobile, real-device or production latency guarantees. Calendar undated sections/day details and manual/batch views remain unbounded.

verification: Downloaded task JSON and pre-import snapshots match canonical full-field task signatures.
Replacement import and confirmed checkpoint restoration preserve all task and subtask fields.
The task state immediately before restoration remains available as a new checkpoint.
Timeline starts with 100 cards; load-more, far-end search and reset behavior preserve correct task data.
